newsitem.title: USA: CDSI gets 79 pct of Control Data Holding.
newsitem.headline: CDSI gets 79 pct of Control Data Holding.

text.p: CDSI Holding Corp said Tuesday about 89 percent of the outstanding common stock, or 79 percent of the fully diluted common stock, of Control Data Systems Inc have been tendered.
CDSI said its wholly owned subsidiary, CDSI Acquisition Corp, completed its cash tender offer for all outstanding shares of common stock of Control Data at $20.25 per share. The offer expired Monday.

CDSI said the offer is being financed by the sale of equity and debt securities to certain investment funds and people affiliated with Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe, and a credit facility provided by NationsBank of Texas NA and Bank of Nova Scotia.
All shares of Control Data Systems common stock not tendered and purchased in the offer will be acquired in a second step merger transaction at the same price of $20.25 per share.
